summary: Frontend-only polish pass on the Featured Stories StoryViewer (iter_10). Logged in as owner theaidept@gmail.com (post-login lands on /admin; navigated manually to /marketplace). Featured Stories reel renders 2 story cards (story-card-2f15bc4a... 'Turnout Gear — Size L' $240 and story-card-4629612b... 'Duty Belt Set' $120). Clicking opens data-testid=story-viewer fullscreen. Verified ALL requested testids: story-video, story-progress (2 sp-seg segments matching 2 stories), story-close, story-mute, story-overlay, story-shop-btn, story-zone-prev/playpause/next, story-next, story-prev. story-buy-card testid was MISSING on the buy card motion.div (had class-only). Fixed in place by adding data-testid=story-buy-card to /app/frontend/src/components/StoryViewer.jsx (allowed test-coverage fix) and re-verified present. Interaction results: (a) story-prev correctly hidden on index 0 and story-next hidden on last index; both desktop arrows work and advance/rewind; (b) tap zones story-zone-prev / story-zone-next change index correctly; (c) mute toggle flips <video>.muted false<->true; (d) X button closes viewer; (e) backdrop click closes viewer; (f) story-shop-btn closes viewer + navigates to /listing/{listing_id} with matching id in URL; (g) auto-advance verified by dispatching 'ended' Event on <video> — first ended advanced to last story (story-next disappeared, story-prev appeared); a second ended on last story closed the viewer, exactly per spec; (h) regression: listings-grid still renders after viewer close, marketplace feed intact. Mobile 390x844: viewer opens, story-buy-card + story-shop-btn present, desktop arrows story-next have computed display:none (correct <560px CSS gate). NOTES (not failures per review instructions): (1) Autoplay: seeded videos are unplayable — <video>.readyState=0, currentTime stays 0, so onTimeUpdate never fires and sp-seg-fill widths remain '0%'. Consistent with iter_8 finding that the seed .mp4 bytes are non-decodable (random-bytes). The autoPlay attribute + muted attribute are wired correctly; plumbing is fine. (2) Because the video never actually plays, tapping story-zone-playpause on the paused (never-started) element calls v.play() which rejects silently — the story-paused-indicator therefore does not appear during this test. This is a byproduct of the un-decodable seed; togglePlay wiring/onPause/onPlay handlers are correct in code. To fully exercise the pause indicator + segment fill live-progress + real onEnded auto-advance in-browser, seed a genuine encoded H.264 MP4 (a few hundred KB) — recommended for the seeder, not a bug in this iter.

action_items: OPTIONAL: replace random-bytes seed videos with a real short H.264 MP4 so the paused indicator, live segment-fill progress, and real onEnded auto-advance can be observed in a browser (not just via synthetic 'ended' event). Not a code bug — code wiring is correct.

critical_code_review_comments: StoryViewer.jsx: backdrop-click close (root div onClick={onClose}) is convenient but easy to trigger accidentally on desktop when overshooting the shop button or arrow. Also raised in iter_8. Consider requiring the explicit close button, or add a small mousedown-inside-stage guard so mouseup outside doesn't count.

StoryViewer.jsx: togglePlay() unconditionally calls v.play() without awaiting the returned promise — if autoplay is blocked or the source can't decode, the rejection is silently swallowed. A .catch(()=>setPaused(true)) would keep UI state in sync when playback fails.

StoryViewer.jsx: keyboard handler binds 'ArrowUp' to prev but touch handler binds swipe-up to next — inconsistent axis semantics. Instagram/TikTok both use up=next for feed reels, so either the keyboard mapping should flip, or add an explicit comment about the intentional divergence.

StoryViewer.jsx: setDir state is only used inside AnimatePresence variants; it triggers a re-render before onIndex causes the parent to update. Minor: consider a ref instead of state for dir to avoid the extra render.

StoryViewer.jsx: <video> has muted={muted} but NOT the boolean 'muted' attribute at initial mount (only prop). Chromium usually still autoplays a muted-by-default video via attribute-only; because muted state defaults to false here, autoplay is more likely to be blocked. Consider initial muted=true (with a visible indicator) for reliable autoplay UX, matching every mainstream stories UI.

Segmented progress: sp-seg-fill only updates from onTimeUpdate; if the browser throttles background tab timeupdate events the segment stalls even though the video keeps playing. Consider a lightweight rAF fallback that reads currentTime while paused==false.

Regression coverage: no unit/e2e test exists for StoryViewer in the repo — a Playwright smoke that exercises the full reel would prevent testid regressions like the story-buy-card one caught this iteration.
